title: Test retained local operation before claiming a full shape-writing machine
statement: The unexecuted $12,300 test uses two adjacent final-outlet cells, a rigid lever with real 10 N load, clamp and forming controls, all nine states, opposite writes, 100 rewrites and ten 24-hour holds. Faults include missed engagement, partial stroke, delayed pin, power loss and calibrated persistent profile change. Independent observations include pose, permanent set, stiffness, torque/work, pin tip, drive separation, temperature, about .1 um wear and load retention after all writer contacts withdraw. The estimate pays 240 h occupancy and metrology. Success would not establish ten-zone mass, all programs, full routing, 100 services or advantage. The $157,500 development/build case is an estimate before campaign execution, not a quotation or spending authority.
